desc.en: A very small Slag. It's very vicious, and its strength does not match up with its size. There are always new stories about treasure hunters who mistake it for a similar type of Slag, let down their guard, and end up in a world of pain.
desc.ja: かなり小さいスラグ。体格に合わない力を秘めており非常に凶暴。同種のスラグと思って油断した結果、痛い目をみるトレジャーハンターが後を絶たない
